evals.name: pr-authoring-title-format
evals.prompt: Create a draft pull request for issue #102 adding support for JWT authentication. Format the title and body properly.
evals.expected_output: A draft PR created with title '[#102] Add JWT authentication support' and structured body using templates/pull_request.md, requesting user confirmation before submission.

evals.name: pr-conflict-resolution-author
evals.prompt: Resolve merge conflicts on PR branch feature/auth against origin/main as the author.
evals.expected_output: Guidance on using an isolated worktree in /tmp/, merging origin/main, resolving conflicts, and standard pushing without force-push.
